headline: Rough day, but earnings week is coming
summary: The book slipped 1.01% today mostly on VRT and CEG weakness, while GOOGL and AAPL held up and cushioned the drop. Nothing broke — just noise ahead of two big earnings dates.
watch: VRT reports earnings tomorrow — expect a big swing, hold through it.
Don't add to VRT until after earnings clears the uncertainty.
AAPL reports earnings in 2 days — hold, don't chase it near $340.08.
GOOGL still down 8.3% overall — hold, let today's bounce build.
Hold NVDA and AVGO — do nothing, thesis is intact.
recap: Book fell 1.01% to $9,675, cash sits at $210.
VRT dropped 6.3% to $269.56, the day's biggest drag, but still up 0.3% overall.
CEG fell 3.8% to $259.82, still only down 0.5% since you bought it.
GOOGL was today's best performer, up 2.2% to $333.71.
AAPL edged up 0.9% to $340.08, still your top winner at +10.5%.
NVDA and AVGO barely moved, both still underwater on your cost.
